rpx_navy_focus_reward = {
	set_variable = {
		rpx_hidden_navy_development_var = {
			value = rpx_hidden_navy_development_var
			add = 3
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = {
		var = rpx_hidden_navy_development_var
		min = 0
		max = 100
	}
}

rpx_setup_navy_state = {
	rpx_calc_navy_baseline = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = rpx_navy_state }
			}
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = rpx_navy_state }
	}
}
